eventTitle: Kulitan Flea Market: Angeles City Youthfest
title: Meet our Kulitan x Angeles City Youth Fest merchants
content:
A little bit of coffee, a little bit of matcha, a little bit of good food, and a whole lot of things to discover. 👀✨
Meet our Kulitan Flea Market x Angeles City Youth Fest merchants this October 9–12 in collaboration with Angeles City Tourism and Brgy. Sto Rosario.✨
Come hungry, come curious, and bring your barkada. 🫶🏻
See you around the loop!
